After configuring the Mozilla VPN preferences for different websites, you may want to review them to confirm they meet your expectations. Follow these steps to do so:
#In the top right corner of your browser, click the Mozilla VPN extension icon.
#;[[Image:extension icon|width=350]]
#In the top right corner of the extension, click the gear icon to access the extension settings.
#;[[Image:Extension setting|width=350]]
#Select '''Website preferences''' from the menu.
#;[[Image:Website preferences|width=350]]
#A new window opens and displays the website preferences.
#;[[Image:Website preferences abc|width=720]]
;*[[Image:VPN letter A]]: The search bar allows you to look for a website from the list.
;*[[Image:VPN letter B]]: The VPN status column indicates which websites are exempt from the VPN protection.
;*[[Image:VPN letter C]]: The VPN location column displays the set country preference for accessing each website.
